_README: Operator-maintained macro / token-unlock calendar for the Phase-2.4 event
features (eventHoursToNext, eventKindNext, eventInTpWindow).
HOW TO USE:
1. Copy this file to a real path OUTSIDE the repo, e.g. /data/macro-calendar.json
2. Fill `events` with dates copied from the OFFICIAL sources below — do NOT
guess dates; a wrong macro date is worse than none.
3. Set MACRO_CALENDAR_FILE=/data/macro-calendar.json in the server .env and
restart. The server logs 'Loaded N macro calendar event(s)' on boot.
NFP (first Friday) and crypto options expiry (last Friday) are already computed
in code — do NOT add them here. This file is only for dates that are NOT
rule-derivable: FOMC, CPI, PCE, token unlocks, ETF-flow prints, etc.
SOURCES (verify each date before adding):
FOMC decision days : federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm
CPI release dates  : bls.gov/schedule/news_release/cpi.htm
PCE release dates  : bea.gov/news/schedule
Token unlocks      : your unlock tracker of choice
SCHEMA: events[] = { kind, iso }.
kind : 'fomc' | 'cpi' | 'pce' | 'unlock' | any string label
iso  : full ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the release/print, e.g.
FOMC statement 2pm ET  = 18:00 or 19:00 UTC (EDT vs EST — check DST)
CPI/PCE/NFP 8:30am ET  = 12:30 or 13:30 UTC (EDT vs EST)

events._comment: PLACEHOLDER — replace with the real FOMC decision datetime from federalreserve.gov, then add the rest of the year.
